scientific_integrity: An unrestricted combinatorial and CW-cell proof is supplied. Finite checks independently corroborate the statement. Equivalent unpublished or unindexed results cannot be excluded. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only shortest-path inclusive Rips scales 1 and 2 of line graphs of connected finite simple base graphs of girth at least six, with pairwise edge-disjoint simple hexagons. No assertion for overlapping hexagons, arbitrary metrics, or higher scales. Computational examples are corroboration, not an all-graph proof.
title: Hexagon-controlled scale-two Rips persistence of line graphs
